Wat ga je doen?

Understanding exactly what a customer needs is essential. Do you believe listening is just as important as speaking? Then keep reading!
 

A selection of your responsibilities:
 

 
• You respond to customer enquiries by telephone and email, identify customers' needs and provide clear, helpful and professional support.
 
• You ensure a smooth and accurate order flow, from receiving orders to invoicing.
 
• You create, update and maintain customer accounts and ensure that customer information is complete and accurate.
 
• You support customers with webshop enquiries, online ordering, account access and other website-related issues.
 
• You assist with the day-to-day aministration of online webshops, including order follow-up, customer questions and issue resolution.
 
• You register and handle returns, claims and complaints in a timely manner and propose ways to prevent recurring issues.
 
• You maintain up-to-date knowledge of products, prices, promotions, procedures and online information to resolve customer questions effectively.
 
• You mainly support B2C customers, while also assisting professional customers such as retailers and wholesalers with orders, service requests and online tools. 

We are looking for the following profile:
 

 
• You are a native English speaker with excellent spoken and written communication skills.
 
• You are customer-focused, empathetic, flexible and a strong communicator.
 
• You are confident handling a high volume of telephone calls and emails while maintaining accuracy and service quality.
 
• You are comfortable using webshops, online platforms, Microsoft Office and customer or order-management systems.
 
• You can set priorities, organize your work and follow customer requests through to completion.
 
• You are enthusiastic, eager to learn and enjoy working as part of a team.
 
• You are comfortable with routine administrative tastks and maintain a positive approach in every customer interaction.
 
• You have a commercial mindset and know how to combine customer focus with result-oriented working.
 
• You are available for a full-time position.

Our client is a dynamic and growing company in the region of Oostende.

Wat ga je doen?                
Rijd regionale distributieritten en lever goederen veilig en punctueel af met oog voor klanttevredenheid.Als CE chauffeur bij onze klant verzorg je regionale distributieritten en lever je goederen veilig en nauwkeurig af aan diverse klanten. Je werkt met een vaste vrachtwagen vanuit Desteldonk en hebt dagelijks contact met een planningsteam dat zorgt voor een duidelijke structuur. Veiligheid, betrouwbaarheid en klantgerichtheid staan centraal in jouw werk.- Je voert regionale of nationale distributieritten uit voor verschillende klanten.- Je vertrekt elke dag vanuit Desteldonk met een vaste vrachtwagen.- Je transporteert goederen veilig en professioneel.- Je volgt het dagschema en zorgt voor stipte leveringen.- Je communiceert op een vriendelijke en professionele manier met klanten.- Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor je routes en materiaal.- Je krijgt ondersteuning van het planningsteam en de HR-afdeling.- Je ontvangt interne opleidingen en begeleiding van ervaren collega’s en coaches.Je werkt van maandag tot vrijdag en start dagelijks tussen 4:00 en 6:00 uur, afhankelijk van je ritplanning.Zin om aan de slag te gaan? Solliciteer vandaag nog — we kijken uit naar je reactie!
                Wie ben jij?                                                                                        
• You are customer-oriented and punctual.                                                                                                
• You take responsibility while on the road.                                                                                                
• You have a flexible and professional attitude.                                                                                                
• You preferably live within a 20-kilometre radius of Desteldonk.                                                                                                
• You enjoy working independently and value clear agreements.                                                                                                
Opleiding: No specific diploma required.
                                                    
Vakkennis: Experience as a driver or in distribution transport is an advantage, but not required.
                                                    
Talenkennis: You speak Dutch, French or English.
                                                    
Attesten: Valid CE driving licence, valid medical fitness certificate, Code 95 Certificate of Professional Competence and digital tachograph driver card.
                                Wat bieden wij jou?                                                                                        
• You receive personal guidance, clear agreements and opportunities to further develop yourself.                                                                                                
• You receive an attractive salary based on your experience.                                                                                                
• A meal allowance of €9 per day worked.                                                                                                
• A dedicated truck that you use to depart from Desteldonk every day.                                                                                                
• A company car after six months, which you may also use for private purposes.                                                            
.

We are looking for a logistic officer for warehouse in Vilvoorde. The company is active in the medical field. You will join the kitting team and provide support to clinical supplies operations and administrative activities in all areas of clinical supplies lifecycle of low to moderate complexity studies.

Your tasks:
 

 
• You support logistics and administrative tasks related to clinical supplies and medical devices. 
 
• You ensure smooth processes for ordering, storage, labelling, shipping, and returns. 
 
• You track inventory levels and expiration dates, and prepare monthly reports.

• You perform routine tasks and prepare the kits for the labs. 
 
• You handle ad-hoc supply purchases when needed. 

 
• You have a good command of English (spoken and written). 
 
• You have at least 2 years of relevant experience in a warehouse environment. 
 
• You are comfortable using computers and electronic equipment. 
 
• You are able to sit for 4–6 hours per day. 
 
• You can lift light objects (up to 7–9 kg). 
 
• You have a solid knowledge of clinical supply processes (e.g. manufacturing, shipping, labeling, auditing). 
 
• You are proficient in Microsoft Office.

Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is a subsidiary of Safran Aircraft Engines, based at Brussels Airport (Zaventem & Steenokkerzeel, Belgium), specialized in the inspection, maintenance and repair (MRO) of the advanced LEAP jet engines that power the latest generation of the Airbus A320NEO & Boeing B737MAX narrow body families. The company is a key player in the integrated CFM international MRO network. With more than 75 years of experience, and up to 20 international Part 145 certifications (EASA/ FAA/ CAAC/ …), Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is recognized as a worldwide center of expertise in the air transport industry. More than a 100 airlines, lessors, private aircraft operators and MRO partners have entrusted their engines to our company. We employ over 600 highly skilled, passionate and enthusiastic employees.

We are looking for an Information Systems Security Manager (ISSM) to strengthen our teams.Your role:

• As an Information Systems Security Manager, you protect the organization's information and digital assets against cyber threats by implementing the Safran Information Systems Security Policy.
• You will report to the Information Systems & Digital Transformation Director.
• You will implement the Safran Information Systems Security Policy within the subsidiary.
• As a member of the SAE and Safran ISSM community, you participate in its activities and act as the local representative at SAESB.
• You manage risks and compliance:
• You verify hardware and software compliance and monitor the execution of remediation plans.
• You drive regulatory compliance (GDPR, NIS2, Part-IS, etc.) and conduct cyber risk assessments.
• You coordinate responses to security incidents in collaboration with SAE and Safran.
• You test the Business Continuity Plan (BCP) and Disaster Recovery Plan (DRP).
• You lead cybersecurity awareness and training programs to strengthen the company's cybersecurity culture.

Your profile:

• 3 to 5 years of experience as an Information Systems Security Manager (ISSM/CISO) within a company of more than 100 employees.
• Experience in an industrial environment is an asset.
• Good technical knowledge of IT and cloud architectures and infrastructures.
• Knowledge of operational security and detection components (SOC, SIEM, EDR protection tools, etc.).
• Knowledge of security standards and frameworks (ISO 27001), regulatory requirements (GDPR, NIS2, EASA Part-IS), and risk analysis methodologies.
• Strong team spirit and ability to work collaboratively.
• Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills.
• Ability to manage stress and urgent situations.
• Organized, rigorous, autonomous, and accountable.
• Fluency in French and English, good Dutch.
Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Belgium, holding either an EU passport or a valid work & residence permit. Please note that we do not provide assistance with visa or permit applications.

For our client, an international company specialized in the management, maintenance and rental of Ground Support Equipment (GSE) for the aviation industry, we are looking for a experienced motivated Welder / Mechanical Assembler. 
As a Welder / Mechanical Assembler, you will be responsible for carrying out welding and metal fabrication work, as well as repairing mechanical components of non-motorized Ground Support Equipment (GSE). You will ensure that all work is performed safely, efficiently and in accordance with technical specifications and quality standards.

Your Responsibilities 
 

 
• Perform welding work using MIG, TIG, stick (electrode) welding and other welding techniques on GSE equipment. 
 

 
• Repair cracks, reinforce structures and manufacture custom metal components. 
 

 
• Assemble and install mechanical parts and components. 
 

 
• Install, adjust and maintain hydraulic and pneumatic systems. 
 

 
• Read and interpret technical drawings and engineering plans. 
 

 
• Carry out inspections and preventive maintenance on welded structures and mechanical components. 
 

 
• Repair and maintain locks, locking mechanisms and other mechanical systems. 
 

 
• Inspect completed work to ensure quality standards are met and provide technical support to colleagues when required. 
 

 
• Properly use and maintain welding equipment, tools and workshop machinery. 
 

 
• Comply with all health, safety and quality procedures. 
 

 
• Record completed work, repairs and material usage accurately. 
 
•  
Work closely with colleagues from the mechanical, electrical and workshop departments to ensure efficient maintenance and repair operations.

 
• You have at least 5 years of experience as a welder and/or mechanical assembler, preferably within the aviation, automotive or heavy industrial sector. 
 

 
• You have a solid knowledge of MIG, TIG and stick (electrode) welding techniques. 
 

 
• You have experience with metal fabrication, construction work and mechanical assembly. 
 

 
• You can confidently read and interpret technical drawings and blueprints. 
 

 
• You understand the properties of different materials and their behaviour during welding and repair work. 
 

 
• You are accurate, quality-driven and committed to working safely. 
 

 
• You are a reliable team player with a strong sense of responsibility. 
 

 
• You have a good command of the English language. 
 

 
• You hold a valid Category B driving licence. 
 
•  
A forklift certificate is considered an advantage. 

 
• You are willing to obtain an airport security badge and airport driving permit.

jobs.occupation: Electromechanical Technician - motors & machinery | Brucargo | ENG
jobs.description:
For a technical maintenance company operating at the airport, we are looking for a Electromechanical Technician – Motors & Machinery. As a Electromechanical Technician – Motors & Machinery, you will be responsible for the maintenance, repair, and servicing of electrical systems on a wide range of Ground Support Equipment (GSE), including pushback tractors, baggage tractors, belt loaders, GPU units, passenger steps, and other motorized vehicles. You will ensure that all electrical systems operate safely, efficiently, and in compliance with current standards.

Your responsibilities include:
 

 
•  
 Performing maintenance, repair, and servicing of electrical systems on GSE equipment (pushback tractors, baggage tractors, belt loaders, GPU units, passenger steps, etc.). 

 
• Troubleshooting and resolving faults in electrical and electronic assemblies. 
 
• Installing, testing, and commissioning electrical systems according to current safety standards and regulations. 
 

 
• Documenting maintenance and repair activities and contributing to technical reports. 
 
•  
Providing on-the-job training to other mechanics on troubleshooting and complex electrical systems. 

 
• Ensuring compliance with legal regulations, safety standards, and quality assurance guidelines. 
 
•  
Keeping tools, equipment, and test devices in good working condition through routine checks and cleaning. 

 
• Preparing equipment for handover to customers or deployment on airport sites. 
 

 
• Coordinating with mechanical, electrical, and workshop technicians to ensure efficient and safe execution of repair and maintenance tasks. 

 
• Completed vocational training as an industrial electrician, electronics technician for industrial engineering, mechatronics technician, or a comparable qualification. 
 
• Extensive experience in the maintenance and repair of electrical systems, ideally in aviation or a related technical field. 
 
• Experience with high voltage equipment, preferably with certification. 
 
• Extensive knowledge of control technology and proficiency in reading circuit diagrams. 
 
• Excellent communication skills to report issues and collaborate with other workshop personnel. 
 
• Good command of local language as well as English language, both spoken and written. 
 
• Class B driving license, additional driving permits are an advantage. 
 
• Possess or are eligible to obtain an airport security pass and an airport driving permit.

For an international company active in the food ingredients industry, we are looking for a motivated Application Lab Assistant Bakery to join the Research & Development team in Vilvoorde. As an Application Lab Assistant Bakery, you will play an important role in the development and improvement of ingredients and applications within the bakery and fat confectionery industry. You will perform practical baking trials, analyse the results and support both existing projects and the development of new products. You will mainly work in a laboratory and pilot plant environment, collaborating closely with different technical teams. Thanks to your practical baking knowledge and analytical mindset, you will contribute to the development and commercialisation of innovative ingredients. Your responsibilities will include: 

 
• Preparing and conducting various baking trials and application tests on bench and pilot scale. 
 
•  
 Evaluating dough and bakery products in terms of processability, quality and machinability. 

 
•  
 Collecting, measuring and accurately analysing data during and after the trials. 

 
•  
 Preparing detailed technical and scientific reports documenting the results and findings. 

 
•  
 Supporting the development and improvement of existing and new product formulations and recipes. 

 
• Assisting in the preparation of technical datasheets, product information and presentations. 
 Supporting product demonstrations and contributing to technical presentations for customers. 

 
•  
 Ensuring that laboratory equipment and infrastructure are properly maintained. 

 
•  
 Following all applicable quality, food safety, EHS and maintenance regulations.

 
• You have a degree in baking or a bachelor's degree in a relevant field, combined with practical experience. 
 
• You preferably have at least 6 months of work experience as a baker or in a similar position. 
 
• You have good practical knowledge of baking processes and understand how dough and ingredients behave during processing. 
 

 
• You are able to evaluate dough in terms of processability and machinability. 
 Experience in product development, formulations and recipes is a plus. 

 
•  
 Knowledge of analytical techniques and experience conducting laboratory or pilot-scale trials are an advantage. 

 
• You have good knowledge of MS Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint. 
 
• You are able to write clear reports and present results in a structured way. 
 
• You are fluent in English, both written and spoken. 
 
•  
 You work accurately, have an analytical mindset and pay attention to detail. 

 
•  
 You have a hands-on mentality and are willing to take initiative. 

 
• You can work independently but also enjoy collaborating with a team. 
 
•  
 You are flexible and can easily adapt to changing tasks and priorities.
